parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no facility/custody ban, and courts have granted relief (record conversion-therapy payout), so nothing in the dossier reaches tier-1 or organised-targeting severity. The worst documented visitor-facing exposure is derisive border handling (single 2025 case) plus a state campaign that represses queer expression, scrubbed LGBT accounts, and has made activism extinct — a state threat-framing climate that raises outing salience and offers thin recourse, including for gender-nonconforming foreign performers. Medication access requires in-person purchase; conversion therapy persists institutionally. These are tier-2/3 exposures without a working visitor-protection layer, and the trajectory is deteriorating — below the 0.65 anchors, above widespread-service-denial ones.
